mapper.select: SELECT d.dog_id, d.username, d.dog_name, u.nickname, d.profile_url FROM tbl_dogs d JOIN tbl_users u ON u.username = d.username WHERE dog_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_calendar (username, dog_id, calendar_title, address, calendar_type, calendar_start_date, calendar_end_date, calendar_description) VALUES (#{calenderDto.username}, #{calenderDto.dogId}, #{calenderDto.calendarTitle}, #{calenderDto.address}, #{calenderDto.calendarType}, #{calenderDto.calendarStartDate}, #{calenderDto.calendarEndDate}, #{calenderDto.calendarDescription})
